name: cosmic_objects_list
title: List objects
description: List objects from the Cosmic bucket with optional filters for type, status, and pagination.

name: cosmic_objects_get
title: Get object
description: Get a single object by ID or by slug and type.

name: cosmic_objects_create
title: Create object
description: Create a new object in the Cosmic bucket. Requires write access.

name: cosmic_objects_update
title: Update object
description: Update an existing object by ID. Requires write access.

name: cosmic_objects_delete
title: Delete object
description: Delete an object by ID. This action is permanent. Requires write access.

name: cosmic_media_list
title: List media
description: List media files with an optional folder filter and pagination.

name: cosmic_media_get
title: Get media file
description: Get one media file by ID, including its URL and metadata.

name: cosmic_media_upload
title: Upload media
description: Upload a media file from a URL or base64 data. Requires write access.

name: cosmic_media_delete
title: Delete media
description: Delete a media file by ID. This action is permanent. Requires write access.

name: cosmic_types_list
title: List object types
description: List object types and their metafield schemas.

name: cosmic_types_get
title: Get object type
description: Get one object type by slug, including its metafields.

name: cosmic_types_create
title: Create object type
description: Create an object type and its metafields. Requires write access.

name: cosmic_types_update
title: Update object type
description: Update an object type's title, metafields, or options. Requires write access.

name: cosmic_types_delete
title: Delete object type
description: Delete an object type and every object of that type. Requires write access.

name: cosmic_blocks_list
title: List content blocks
description: List reusable rich-text Content Blocks, the {{name /}} tokens available in rich-text fields.

name: cosmic_ai_generate_text
title: Generate text
description: Generate text with Cosmic AI. Requires write access.

name: cosmic_ai_generate_image
title: Generate image
description: Generate an image or SVG and upload it to the media library. Requires write access.

name: cosmic_ai_generate_video
title: Generate video
description: Generate a video and upload it to the media library. Requires write access.

name: cosmic_ai_generate_audio
title: Generate audio
description: Generate speech from text and upload it to the media library. Requires write access.

name: cosmic_agent_signup
title: Create agent project
description: Create an unclaimed Cosmic project for a human email. Served at /v1/agent, not on the bucket endpoint.

name: cosmic_agent_verify
title: Verify agent project
description: Submit the 6-digit code from the claim email. Served at /v1/agent.

name: cosmic_agent_status
title: Get agent status
description: Read claim status, plan, and limits for the agent key. Served at /v1/agent.
